# Shelter on the Land

Free plans, design tools and experienced guidance for small earthen shelters. Public editorial and service pages are available as readable HTML.

- [Building System / Open Set](https://shelter.onthe.land/plans/): Start with one room and grow through a shared building language.
- [Shelters](https://shelter.onthe.land/shelters/): Four Walls, Courtyard and Long House plan collections.
- [Packages](https://shelter.onthe.land/packages/): Compare the free plans and ways of working with Shelter.
- [Supported](https://shelter.onthe.land/supported/): Help with pre-construction decisions.
- [Guided](https://shelter.onthe.land/guided/): Guidance through preparation and construction.
- [Custom](https://shelter.onthe.land/packages/#custom): Site-specific design described in the Custom package.
- [Process](https://shelter.onthe.land/#process): Steps from choosing a plan to building with support.
- [About](https://shelter.onthe.land/#about): Shelter on the Land and contact information.

Sitemap: https://shelter.onthe.land/sitemap.xml
